conventions.new_book: Choose the logical subsystem, explain purpose and actual caller/reference model, reuse an existing leaf where coherent, and register a public namespace in docs/prefixes.md. Add an explicit catalog note only when filename/prefix ownership or root discovery is ambiguous.
conventions.explicit_root: extra_roots entries require path, category, source and reason for a computed/dynamic loader that static source reading cannot resolve.
conventions.superseded: book_notes may name superseded only with replacement and evidence; keep historical/proof/test/generation uses visible. It never authorizes deletion.
conventions.later_cleanup: Inspect actual callers, semantic/guard differences, registry/scenario and image/extraction uses; coordinate leases and certify affected roots in a quiet batch before consolidation. Unreachability alone is insufficient.
